title: Colours and markers
text: Red block : Pitfall — real traps, counter-intuitive behaviour, and usage that can crash/UAF/race. Read these first. Orange block : Note — contracts such as threading, lifetime and paint order. Not necessarily an error, but violating them usually leads to one. Green block : Recommended — preferred usage, ownership models and best practices. Plain bullets are ordinary semantics, defaults or version changes; they are not automatically risk-free.

title: Namespaces and headers
text: Everything is in namespace ZufyUI . Headers are layered by usage : ZufyUI.h : core — types / signals / fonts / element base / layout / menus / window. ZufyUIAcrylic.h : hand-written DComp composition effects + the official acrylic/mica recipes (included by ZufyUI.h ). ZufyUIWidgets.h : basic controls (Label/Button/TextBox/TextEdit/ComboBox/…/ScrollViewer/TabView/icons), includes ZufyUI.h . ZDataViewer.h : data views (ListView/TableView/TreeView), depends on the two above. ZufyUICharts.h : charts (BarChart/LineChart/PieChart) , depends on ZufyUI.h . ZufyUIImages.h : Image / ImageManager (image loading and device cache). ZufyUIIcons.h : the FontIcon glyph control (the Icon enum itself lives in ZufyUIWidgets.h ). ZufyUIWindowTool.h : window extras (title bar / MessageBox / tray / system dialogs / accessibility provider / debug channel); since v1.20.0 it includes ZufyUIWidgets.h itself , so it can be included on its own; it includes ZufyUIHwndView.h at the end. ZufyUIHwndView.h : native HWND host HwndView (WebView2 / camera / third-party / out-of-process windows). ZufyUIDragDrop.h : drag & drop (included at the end of ZufyUI.h ). ZufyUIDsl.h : optional fluent construction DSL (purely additive; changes no existing control). All are header-only ; #pragma comment(lib, ...) auto-links d2d1 / dwrite / dwmapi / imm32 / winmm . Source encoding : .h / .cpp files containing non-ASCII (e.g. Chinese) must be saved as UTF-8 with BOM (otherwise MSVC decodes them with the local code page and reports C2143/C2259/C2888/C4819 ); .md / .tex are saved as UTF-8 without BOM . For a BOM-free / ASCII-only copy, use tools/export_ascii.py (output dist/ascii , not committed; see the README's "ASCII-only export").

title: Units
text: All coordinates and sizes are DIP (device-independent pixels), not physical pixels. The framework snaps to the physical pixel grid via Snap() before drawing; you do not do DPI math yourself. Mouse event coordinates are DIP too. Screen coordinates only appear in system APIs ( Create , ShowAt , FileDialog ).  Pitfall the Snap DPI scale is thread-local ( GlobalDpiScaleRef ). The render thread sets it every frame; the UI thread now sets it too in Window::Create / WM_DPICHANGED . On your own threads it will be 1.0, not the window DPI.

title: Object model & lifetime
text: Controls are owned by std::shared_ptr<T> , created with std::make_shared<T>() . Mount to a parent via the container's AddChild() ; the parent holds the child's shared_ptr — the child survives as long as the parent . Detached with no other shared_ptr , the element is destroyed; destruction auto-releases its offscreen cache and registered connections (internal ConnectionGroup ).  Recommended ownership model Controls are owned by std::shared_ptr ; the parent container holds children via AddChild . Use raw pointers or weak_ptr for cross-layer references; do not hold a parent's shared_ptr back, and do not let two containers own the same control.  Pitfall UIElement::SetParent stores a raw (non-owning) pointer; ownership always lives in the container/ Application shared_ptr . An element records its window only as a window id , to avoid UAF if the window is destroyed first.

title: Signals & events
text: Bind with Connect(signal, slot) , returns a Connection , auto-disconnected when the host element is destroyed. The slot may be any callable (lambda / function pointer / std::function ).  Pitfall do not connect a lambda that captures the host's own shared_ptr by value to the host's own signal — reference cycle, the whole subtree leaks. See the "Events & Signals" chapter.

title: Defaults
text: Every control has inline static Default* fields (e.g. Button::DefaultSize ). static SetDefault*() affects only instances created afterwards ; instance setters affect only that instance.  Pitfall static defaults are process-global ; for different looks across windows, set before creating, or use per-instance setters.

title: Three cross-cutting concepts (all controls)
text: Enabled/disabled : UIElement::SetEnabled(false) makes the element and subtree non-interactive (mouse/keyboard blocked); controls decide graying via IsEffectivelyEnabled() . Disabled does not change layout (still occupies space). SetEnabled(false) ≠ SetVisible(false) . Focus : only elements whose IsFocusable() returns true can take keyboard focus. Tab traversal moves focus; the focus ring shows only when focus comes from Tab, not mouse. Offscreen cache : see the "Element base" chapter. On by default; turn it off with SetUseCache(false) for frequently-animating / many-instance controls to save VRAM.

title: Minimal program
Event loop & threading
text: Application::Run() runs the single message loop; all windows/controls must be created and touched on the same UI thread . To touch UI from a worker: use a signal's ConnectionThread::UIThread , or detail::PostToUIThread . The render thread ( ZUFYUI_RENDER_THREAD ) is off by default and documented as unstable / not recommended.

title: Structure (outer → inner)
text:
Application (process) → Window (top-level, optionally owned/modal) → root Layout (default ColumnBox ) → containers ( Card / PageHost / TabView / ScrollViewer /data views/…) → controls.
Overlays (menus/dropdowns/tooltips/system dialogs) use separate windows or a global overlay — not the root tree.

title: ConnectionThread
text: cpp Copy enum class ConnectionThread { CurrentThread , NewThread , UIThread }; enum class ConnectionThread { CurrentThread, NewThread, UIThread };  CurrentThread (default): slot runs synchronously on the firing thread. NewThread : spawns a detached thread per Fire — do not touch UI inside; a running slot cannot be cancelled midway; not suitable for high-frequency signals — use UIThread or your own pool instead. UIThread : posts the slot to the UI thread (the correct way to update UI from workers); queued tasks check liveness and skip after disconnect / receiver destruction.  Pitfall Fire should run on the UI thread by default; firing from a worker with CurrentThread slots runs UI slots on that worker — that is a caller contract violation. For cross-thread firing, use UIThread slots or guarantee subscriber lifetime yourself. NewThread + a raw this capture + a receiver that may die early = UAF; use ConnectWeak to keep it alive, or UIThread .  Version : cross-thread/locking semantics hardened in v1.15.0 ; queued tasks gained liveness checks in v1.24.0 .

text: The DSL form is a signal member pointer: .on<&Button::Clicked>(...) , .on<&ToggleSwitch::Toggled>(...) . The core signal form also works: btn->Connect(btn->Clicked, ...) . There is no Button::OnClicked and no chained .On(...) . Button::Clicked is legal only in a member-pointer position such as .on<&Button::Clicked> .

title: Version digest
text: Only the changes that affect your code are listed. v1.15.0 : data-view virtualization ( SetItemCount etc.) + hide/filter/visible-order sort (two coordinate systems); cross-thread/locking hardening; ComboBox source-index API; TreeView::BeginUpdate/SetNodeText . v1.16.0 : system dialogs FileDialog / ColorDialog ; UIZSignals::Error ; render thread off by default + documented unstable; tray callback-message collision fix; optional ZUFYUI_ENABLE_COMCTL_V6 . v1.17.0 : UIA accessibility (on by default); external debug/automation channel ( SetDebugEnabled , off by default, commands 1~22); layout stretch weights ( ColumnBox / RowBox / GridLayout distribute leftover by weight); automatic ellipsis tooltips (Label/Button); CaptionButton::Kind::Pin ; TreeView node bgColor / Get/SetScrollOffsetY / ScrollToNode ; Window::DefaultBackdropColor pure white. v1.18.0 : New ZufyUICharts.h : ChartBase / BarChart / LineChart / PieChart ; BarChart horizontal orientation; PieChart wheel zoom. New TextEdit multi-line editor/viewer; TextRun ; base AcceptsTab() . UIElement::ReleaseDeviceResourcesRecursive() ; PageHost delayed hidden-page cache release (~1.2 s); ScrollViewer::UseCache()=false ; SetUseCache(false) frees immediately. Library fixes: Snap DPI scale also set on the UI thread; ZSignal::Fire RAII exception safety; TextBox shift+click; Slider zero-width NaN guard; ListView pooled-label re-measure on width change ( poolW_ ). v1.19.0 : New drag & drop ( ZufyUIDragDrop.h ): Window::BeginDrag + DragDataBuilder ; element SetDropTargetEnabled / OnDragEnter/Over/Leave/Drop + signals; Label / Button / TextBox / TextEdit / ComboBox accept and start drags; drag files out to Explorer. New Expander (collapsible card: smoothstep easing + rotating arrow + header hover highlight), SettingsList (settings rows); image display uses Label::SetImage + SetImageFit (scale to fully visible). ComboBox dropdown arrow is now a chevron that rotates with expansion. Text drag now has move semantics: the source deletes the original selection first, then inserts at the drop point (private format dedups same-control drags). v1.19.1 : TextEdit undo/redo switched to the standard scheme (stack top = current state): both undo and redo restore the selection and cursor of that point; Backspace/Delete/typing/paste are one step each; drop insert/move are undoable and redoable. ScrollViewer : content is measured at the viewport width (fixes "clipped cards" and wrong scroll range from an infinite desired width for FillWidth/wrapping content); content is measured twice (re-measured at the narrower width once a vertical bar appears); the content element's own margin is honored ; the clip gets a 1px bleed so edge borders are not cut in half. The drop caret now shows even when the target is unfocused ; during a drag the source selection is preserved and a preview caret shows at the drop point; dropping inside the original selection is a no-op. Expander : header hover highlight (no longer covering the card border), arrow rotates with the collapse easing, SetIcon leading icon. Whole-window drag & drop: Window::SetDropTargetEnabled + window-level DragEnter/DragOver/DragLeave/Drop . Image display merged into Label (new SetImageFit ); the standalone ImageView is removed. v1.19.2 : New top menu bar MenuBar (VS-style: click opens the Menu ; hovering only highlights, no auto-expand ; the open entry stays pressed until the menu closes; overlaid on the custom title bar by default, empty areas pass through so the title bar stays draggable). New bottom status bar StatusBar (left/right panels: optional icon + text). Window : SetMenuBar / SetStatusBar / SetMenuBarInTitleBar / SetShowTitleText (title text and an on-title-bar menu are mutually exclusive ). Menu gains an onClosed callback; MenuWindow::OnPopupClosed . v1.19.3 : New theme system ( ThemeRole / Theme / ThemeManager ; Light/Dark/HighContrast ; window-level SetTheme ; UIZSignals::ThemeChanged/ThemeReapply ) — one palette by role; re-applied to the visible subtree on page/tab switch. Follow system : reads the registry light/dark + system accent, handles WM_SETTINGCHANGE / WM_THEMECHANGED / WM_DWMCOLORIZATIONCOLORCHANGED / WM_SYSCOLORCHANGE ; ThemeManager::SetFollowSystem(bool) . Explicit instance color wins : once a control's Set*Color is called it is flagged "user-colored" and the theme no longer overrides it; ListView items / TableView cells+rich cells / TreeView cells / headers / alternating rows / Tab selected+hover / radio / NumberBox hover / CheckBox hover all themed. Backdrop token (window base white/black); window periphery (caption buttons) follows the system theme; ThemeManager::Map color remap. Fixes: ThemeReapply connection leak (UAF); SyncThemeBackdrop swallowing user tint; ListView/TableView/TreeView theme overriding per-item colors. v1.19.4 : New DSL ( ZufyUIDsl.h ): Ref<T> ( with/on/add + layout shortcuts), Make<T> , Col/Row/Grid and per-control short factories — fluent construction / subtree assembly / signal wiring; demo gains a "DSL" page. Fix: CheckBox hard-coded width_/height_ in its ctor → treated as a fixed width in RowBox/ColumnBox and the label was clipped . ListView/TableView RefreshChildren cache criteria collapsed into a single signature ChildrenSig() (criteria in one place, harder to forget); consistent with TreeView . ChartBase::MeasureOverride : falls back to 420×260 when fill but unconstrained/no size (no longer collapses to 0). Window::SetMinSize default content measure gets a 600 DIP width floor; pch.h ZufyUI_DEBUG now #ifdef _DEBUG ; Theme::HighContrast role colors distinguished (no longer all-yellow). v1.19.5 : DSL enhancements: dsl::App() / WindowApp window builder (fluent config + run() ); Page()/Menu()/Settings() short factories; SFINAE-gated per-control sugar ( text/checked/value/placeholder/padding/category/series/slice/item/menu ). The demo "DSL" page uses the sugar and chart composition ( Pie().slice(...) , Bar().category(...).series(...) , Progress().value(...) ). v1.19.6 : Fix: ListView button mode checkbox hit test was 4px off (now aligned with the draw / child left edge). Fix: Label::MeasureOverride wrap branch ignored inline children width (wrapping Labels with AddChild squeezed/overflowed text). Docs: version is now a single source ( API.md / README.md headers reference the ZufyUI.h macro; the generator mdapi2html.py injects 1.27.0 ); cleaned stale items ( ImageView default row, Sort → SortItems , Menu::onClosed , chart fill wording, README menu +90MB history entry); mdapi2html.py fixes --theme auto semantics and c++ -style language names in the code-fence regex. v1.19.7 : Fixes: ChartBase swapped horizontal/vertical scrollbar allowance ( viewW uses the vertical bar, viewH the horizontal) → rightmost/bottom content unreachable; NumberBox wheel focus check (focus is on the inner TextBox ); lastActiveAnimElements_ dangling (erased from the anim sets on destruction, prevents random crashes); Menu::ShowAt throwing bad_weak_ptr when not shared-owned; ChildrenSig missing EnsureView ; TreeView::SetDefaultExpandDepth not applied by AddRoot / AddChild . Fixes: ColumnBox / RowBox spacing counts only layout-participating children; GridLayout row/col count skips invisible; Label wrap ignored/duplicated spacing; ListView / TableView clear childrenView_ before releasing labels and release pooled/rich/cell labels; Window::defaultIMC_ via ImmAssociateContext ; DragData::GetFiles buffer len+1 ; TextEdit fires SelectionChanged when clearing a selection; MessageBox default title localized. Added TODO.md (merges the former FEATURE_PLAN.md / OPTIMIZATION_PLAN.md ; the single authoritative backlog). v1.20.0 : DSL : root() now accepts any Layout subclass (previously only Col had a dedicated overload, so Row / Grid failed to compile because Ref → shared_ptr<Layout> needs two user-defined conversions ); titleBar/menuBar/statusBar likewise take a Ref<T> directly. DSL : add() dispatches on the container's real API ( ColumnBox / RowBox / Label → AddChild ; PageHost → AddPage , skipping non- Page arguments; GridLayout goes through the new coordinate API). Added dsl::Cell(row,col,child[,rowSpan,colSpan]) and Ref::cell , the apply() escape hatch, and Wrap() . DSL : more shortcuts — size limits ( minWidth/minHeight/maxWidth/maxHeight/minSize/maxSize ), stretch weights ( weight/hWeight/vWeight ), cache/bleed/clipRect/noClip/cursor/dropTarget/contextMenuEnabled/accessible , spacing (single-arg on Col / Row , two-arg on GridLayout ), padding(Thickness) , background/textColor , align (GridLayout); per-control sugar gained image/imageFit/items/rows/cols/header/cell/root(s)/separator/submenu ; new factories RadioGroup()/ScrollBar()/Glyph() ( Image is a resource object, not a UIElement , so it has no factory — use the Label::SetImage sugar). DSL : WindowApp::run() now calls Show() — Window::Create does not show the window, so the previous implementation ran a message loop with no window (looked like a hang); added hidden/minSize/position/frameRateLimit/theme/useAppTheme/dropTarget/icon/titleBarVisible/showTitleText/menuBarInTitleBar and the window signal hook on<&Window::Closed> ( Window 's signals are plain members, there is no Connect ); WindowApp is now movable (it holds a unique_ptr<Window> , because Window itself is neither copyable nor movable). Fix : null guards in ColumnBox / RowBox / GridLayout::AddChild — the DSL's variadic forwarding can pass nullptr , which used to dereference a null pointer. Fix : ZufyUIWindowTool.h was not self-contained — it used Label / Button / ColumnBox::AddChild without including ZufyUIWidgets.h , relying on the caller to include it first ( pch.h happened to do so); the include is now present and the header can be included on its own. Tooling : new tools/build.ps1 (one shot: auto-fix BOM before building → kill processes holding files → build demo + ZufyUIDebugger → run self-tests), tools/ensure_bom.ps1 (adds a UTF-8 BOM only to C++ sources that contain non-ASCII and lack one, preventing the GBK misparse behind C2143/C2259/C2888/C4819 ), and tests/zufyui_tests.cpp + tools/run_tests.ps1 (47 compile-time/runtime assertions, no window created, runnable from a shell or CI). v1.21.0 : Fix : Card flashed a blue hover border — the theme applier set SetHoverBorderColor(Accent) on cards, a behaviour cards never had; removed (hover still changes the background). Fix : ProgressBar inner fill radius no longer matched the outer frame after stretching — the track, the clip geometry and the border still used the member height_ (construction-time height) while only the fill used the arranged height; all three now use arrangedRect_.height / 2 . Fix : Button captions were ellipsized even with room to spare — MeasureOverride returned a constant width_ (set to DefaultWidth = 120 in the constructor); it now grows to fit the text ( max(width_, textWidth + 2*padding) ), with Button::AutoSizeToText (static, default true ) and SetAutoSizeToText(false) . This is a layout behaviour change. New : ToggleSwitch uses duration-driven ease-in-out ( DefaultAnimationDuration = 0.25s , stops exactly on time); also fixes mouse-click/keyboard paths that bypassed SetOn and therefore never started the animation (the "instant snap"). New : ProgressBar value easing ( DefaultValueAnimDuration = 0.22s ; fill and percentage text move together). New : SplitView collapse : dragging within the edge threshold first shows an "about to collapse" overlay (translucent accent + direction arrow, alpha fade, content untouched ); the pane collapses on release (size eases to 0); afterwards a small button is drawn on top of the content at that edge (rounded light grey + arrow pointing in the expand direction + hover easing), and clicking it eases that side from 0 to its minimum limit. SetCollapseEnabled(false) disables the whole feature. Public API: SetCollapseEnabled/IsCollapseEnabled/SetCollapseThreshold/CollapseFirst/CollapseSecond/Expand/IsFirstCollapsed/IsSecondCollapsed/GetCollapsedSide/IsCollapsing/GetCollapseProgress/SetExpandButtonColors/SetExpandButtonSize plus the CollapsedChanged(int) signal. New : detail::EaseOutCubic / detail::EaseInOutCubic (duration-driven easing, one shared convention for in-library animations). New : ThemeRole::Shadow ( appended at the end of the enum so existing values keep their numbers) with Light/Dark/HighContrast values; UIElement::DefaultShadowColor / SetDefaultShadowColor ; Window::SetBackdrop(Backdrop) follows the theme (the tint overload means "locked") plus the ApplyThemeToBackdropParams hook. Fix : PieChart Ctrl+wheel zoom did nothing — PieChart 's own zoom_ shadows ChartBase::zoom_ , so delegating to the base only changed the base's copy; the pie now handles Ctrl itself via SetZoom . Semantics are explicit: Ctrl+wheel = zoom / plain wheel = pan only . Fix : chart wheel panning "did not move" — the wheel path was missing SyncScrollPositions() (it changed scrollX_/scrollY_ but never recomputed baseX_/baseY_ ). Fix : documented that ColumnBox arranges a child without an explicit width at the available width (horizontal stretch ignores the weight) — so "make a card hug its content" means wrapping it in a Row ; and that a SettingsList placed in a Card 's built-in GridLayout (auto columns pass FLT_MAX ) degenerates to zero width — use SetLayout(Col(...)) + SetFillWidth(true) . Tooling : tests/zufyui_tests.cpp 62 → 85 assertions (regressions for this batch: button auto-size on/off, label width follows text, progress/toggle easing convergence, SplitView collapse and expand-to-minimum). v1.22.0 ( contains breaking API changes ): Fix : MessageBox (and any modal) first click falling through to the window behind — when a modal is opened from inside Window::OnMouseUp 's slot, that function's trailing ReleaseCapture() only runs after the modal loop ends, so the main window keeps SetCapture for the whole modal and Windows routes mouse input to the capture window; Window::RunModal now does if (GetCapture()) ReleaseCapture(); before entering the loop. Fix : ScrollViewer scroll chaining — it no longer swallows the wheel at the top/bottom (returns false to bubble up the parent chain when that axis can't scroll further), so the outer page keeps scrolling. Fix : SplitView expand had no easing + expand button jumped sides — the old Expand() cleared the collapsed flags before starting the animation, but PaneLengths keyed off them; now a single collapseSide_ drives both directions and is cleared only when the animation finishes. Breaking · P0-1 : member functions with default arguments split into non-defaulted overloads (so .with() works): TreeView::SetCheckable(bool) + SetCheckableShallow(bool) ; SetNodeCheckable(node,bool) + SetNodeCheckableRecursive ; SetNodeEnabled(node,bool) + SetNodeEnabledRecursive ; SetNodeCheckState(node,state) + SetNodeCheckStateFull(...,updateChildren,updateParent) ; ListView::AddItem(text) and rich-item AddItemWidget(shared_ptr<Label>) (old name dropped); RadioGroup::AddItem / AddItemSelected / AddButton / AddButtonSelected ; Menu::AddCheckItem(text,checked) / AddCheckItemCb / AddCheckItemRadio . New · P0-2 : collision-free aliases make_slider/make_card/make_page/make_menu/make_menu_bar/make_status_bar/make_radio_group/make_scroll_bar/make_expander . New · P1-2 : Page::SetScrollableContent(content) — one line wraps the whole page in a ScrollViewer + margin. New · P1-4 : ThemeManager::RegisterHook / RegisterSubtreeApplier return a RAII HookHandle (auto-disconnect on destruction); the library's own fixed hooks use RegisterHookPermanent / RegisterSubtreeApplierPermanent . Docs · P3 : added docs/pitfalls.md ; AGENTS.md gained a "chaining / API conventions" section. v1.22.1 : Fix (layout) : RowBox / ColumnBox ArrangeOverride did not clamp each child's base to its min/max before distributing leftover → a child with SetMinWidth/Height pushed its extra space onto a stretching sibling, overflowing the row/column (classic case: a SetMinWidth label + SetFillWidth slider → the slider grew too long and spilled outside its card). Now base = clamp(base, min, max) before computing leftover. Behaviour : ColumnBox / RowBox / GridLayout no longer shrink content — insufficient space now overflows and is left to an outer ScrollViewer (desktop UI does not compress content). GridLayout dropped its proportional row/column compression on overflow. Fix (alignment) : GridLayout 's SetHorizontalAlignment/SetVerticalAlignment never took effect because the test colStretchWeights.empty() was always false; now it checks "all zero", so Center/End work (only when no column/row stretch weight is set). Fix (text/IME) : TextBox / TextEdit now merge UTF-16 surrogate pairs (emoji / beyond-BMP) and insert them as one unit; ←/→ , Backspace , Delete move/delete across the whole pair. On losing focus the control clears its own composition state and the Window cancels the IME composition ( ResetImeState() ) — both control and program IME state reset. TextBox::SetImeEnabled(false) also clears composition. Fix (accessibility) : GetAutomationIdOrAuto() now uses a per-window counter ( Window::NextAccessibleAutoId() ), so multi-window/multi-root ids no longer collide; ElementProviderFromPoint descends child-before-parent to the deepest hit (e.g. a Button embedded in a Label). Fix : data view item/cell placement bleedY is read from each element's GetBleed() (no longer a fixed 3.0f ), so shadows/bleed aren't clipped; indicatorY_ is initialised to -1 so the selection indicator snaps on the first frame. Fix (visual) : the focus ring uses ThemeRole::FocusRing and Theme::cornerRadius (was a hard-coded blue + fixed 4); in WM_NCHITTEST the custom title-bar buttons take priority over the resize border (the maximize-button corner is no longer taken by HTTOPRIGHT → Win11 Snap Layouts can appear). Engineering : pch.h no longer includes the library headers (editing a lib header no longer rebuilds the whole PCH); added UIElement::MarkUserColor() centralising 40+ "user colour" markers; removed dead code ListView::FindEnabledFrom . v1.23.0 : New · ZufyUIHwndView.h ( HwndView ) : native HWND content host. Because the main window is NRB+DComp (child HWNDs are not composited), it uses a top-level owned popup as the host; SetContentHwnd re-parents the external window as its WS_CHILD (cross-process allowed) and shows it. Moving the host moves the child natively; clipping = host client + SetWindowRgn (element rect ∩ window client ∩ ancestor GetClipRect , incl. the ScrollViewer viewport). Supports SetObscured , SetOnBoundsChanged , SetFill* . New · Window external-visual attachment : CreateExternalVisual() (WinRT ContainerVisual inserted atop the root visual, for WebView2 put_RootVisualTarget ), SetExternalVisualBounds (DIP→physical px), RemoveExternalVisual ; AddOverlaySync/RemoveOverlaySync/SyncOverlays (unified overlay sync). Performance : overlay sync is now a single window-level point ( WM_MOVE/WM_SIZE/WM_DPICHANGED immediate + one shared 16ms fallback timer) instead of a per-instance timer; DPI/client cached; redundant SetWindowPos skipped and SWP_NOSIZE/NOMOVE used as appropriate; the demo's color pattern is cached into a DIB. Fix · NumberBox : the empty-text error clears once the text becomes a valid number ; ResetToDefault force-clears the error after notifying the app; step/clear buttons fire on press (no re-check against the moving rect; fixes staying red after the × button). Fix · data-view fill : ListView / TableView / TreeView MeasureOverride honours SetFillWidth/SetFillHeight (like charts) instead of always returning the default 200/400. Demo : new "Native HWND" page (GDI color pattern + Card/Grid/Column/ScrollViewer layouts + an out-of-process --outproc producer window hosted by HwndView ). v1.23.1 : Fix (layout / hit-testing) : PageHost::MeasureOverride now measures every page . Previously PageHost only arranged pages while Page::Arrange re-measured solely on a size change, so page content made visible at runtime (e.g. an Expander card revealed after a combo-box selection) was never re-measured: the new element kept a zero arrangedRect (no border, HitTest failed) until the window was resized. Clean pages hit the Measure cache, so no duplicate work is added. v1.23.2 : Build : added /bigobj to the Debug|Win32 / Debug|x64 configurations of ZufyUI.vcxproj / ZufyUIDebugger.vcxproj (Release already had it); the full Release/Debug matrix passes. v1.23.3 : Button : the internal Label is a real child now (rich content via GetLabel()->AddChild / SetContent ); added the drop 2x2 switches ( SetDropWriteBack / SetDropOpenOnClick ) and a single-select menu ( DropSelected / DropMenuOpened ). Fix ? drop-menu position : GetDpiScale() returns 96/144 (not 1.0/1.5); the old multiplier sent the menu to the screen bottom-right. Dividing by 96 places it under the button, and the demo no longer shows a MessageBox. Fixes : SetBackdrop(Acrylic/Mica) no longer covers the system material with opaque white when no tint is set; ListView::SetItemHeight is clamped to >=1px and Draw/hit-testing no longer divide by zero. Docs/cleanup : documented HwndView cross-process risks; removed the redundant WM_ACTIVATE check, added <cstring> , removed the demo's empty callback. v1.24.0 ( contains breaking changes ): Signal lifetime : ConnectionState::alive is atomic; Connection::disconnect / receiver destruction logically cancels pending UIThread / NewThread tasks; Fire concurrent with signal destruction is explicitly UB. Receiver context : UIElement / Window derive from ConnectionOwner ; elem->Connect(...) / Connect(elem, ...) / sig.connect(elem, ...) disconnect with the receiver; added free Connect and ConnectWeak . Breaking : ZSignal is neither copyable nor movable; member-function pointers use Connect(elem, sig, &Class::Method) / ConnectWeak ; elem->Connect(sig, &Class::Method) is no longer supported. Notes : Menu / MenuItem / Timer still use signal.connect and do not auto-disconnect; signal arguments are passed as lvalues. v1.25.0 : New · Drawer : left/right/top/bottom × Overlay / Push / Permanent; rounded scrim, rounded panel/border/outer shadow, Esc and outside-click dismiss. New · Window::AddKeyHandler / RemoveKeyHandler : temporary window-level key handlers. Improvement : ScrollViewer clip bleed follows the content GetBleed() ; tests renamed to zufyui_tests , signal-focused and Drawer tests added (213 assertions). v1.27.0 : Windows 10 Acrylic : enable ACCENT_ENABLE_HOSTBACKDROP before creating the HostBackdropBrush on Win10, preserving the custom blur/tint/noise chain; stop writing Win11-only DWM attributes on Win10. DWM / Snap : keep DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea({1,1,1,1}) for custom frames on both Win10 and Win11; reapply frame state after WM_SIZE / WM_WINDOWPOSCHANGED , fixing lost borders/shadows after Snap. Render driver : added RenderDriver / SetRenderDriver() / GetActiveRenderDriver() / GetRenderDeviceName() ; the demo supports --warp / --gpu and a restart-based home-page switcher. WARP changes only application content rendering; DWM/Compositor may still use the GPU. Breaking : removed the public corner API WindowCorner , SetWindowCorner() , GetWindowCorner() and DSL corner() ; Win10 stays square, Win11 follows DWM, and custom corners require calling Win32 DWM APIs directly. Controls/demo : title-bar glyphs fall back correctly to Segoe MDL2 Assets on Win10; the maximize button refreshes after Snap/restore; UI animation updates pause during drag/resize. v1.26.0 : Layout : explicit Grid size constrains cell measurement; finite Row/Column main-axis allocation for Fill; Card/Page/ScrollViewer honour explicit sizes when empty; Button measures content with autoSize disabled; Label explicit width wraps; ScrollViewer no longer re-measures in Arrange. UIA : provider cache/context lifetime synchronized with COM callback threads, fixing CFG FAST_FAIL_GUARD_ICALL_CHECK_FAILURE . Controls : Expander first-expand/collapse-re-expand/clipping fixes; ToggleSwitch press-drag; Slider immediate drag, click/snap easing, GetDisplayValue() .

title: Pitfall index
text: Pitfall index Color : components are [0,1]; use Color::FromArgb for integers. Size/layout : SetWidth/Height = fixed size; SetFill* = fill parent axis; stretch weights distribute leftover space (v1.17.0); charts default to weight 0, SetFill* takes effect when the parent gives a constraint and falls back to 420×260 otherwise (v1.19.4). Window min size : set SetMinSize explicitly for windows with long text/charts, or the content measure blows it up. Repaint : RequestRepaint() marks only, does not schedule a frame ; don't force a frame there (continuous re-render stutter). InvalidateLayout() bubbles; InvalidateLayoutSelf() does not (pool/virtual rebind). Cache : on by default; SetUseCache(false) for per-frame/heavy controls; release subtrees with ReleaseDeviceResourcesRecursive() . Text : SetTextFast doesn't repaint (pool only); FontManager layouts/formats are shared read-only; GetFormat 's shared format is ParagraphAlignment=CENTER , so multi-line custom drawing needs NEAR or GetStyledLayout . Signals : Fire iterates a snapshot (safe disconnect); Connection destructor doesn't disconnect; DrawOverlay must filter by window; avoid self-capturing shared_ptr lambdas; AddKeyHandler handlers run from a snapshot, so removal does not cancel the current pass. Data views : source-index vs. visible-order coordinates; Sort rearranges + clears multi-select, SortView only reorders; parent is weak_ptr ; row background via node->bgColor ; SetFilter / SetViewComparator store lambdas; row height must be > 0. Multi-line editor : Tab indents; rich text is read-only; wrap-width change rebuilds all line layouts. Scrollbar : hosts reserve a gutter via ShrunkWidthRatio ; idle shrink is lazy . Drawer : SetContent is the main content and SetPanel is the drawer panel; SetPanelSize is the outer size and the default 16 px padding eats into content; Permanent ignores Close ; the scrim only works in Overlay+Modal, and SetScrimOpacity(0) still blocks clicks. Window extras : Window has no size/DPI-change signal; StatusBar::AddPanel has no click callback; taskbar COM failures are silent, and FLASHW_CAPTION does nothing for a custom title bar. Accessibility/debug : role drives exposed UIA Patterns; send debug commands with a timeout. DSL ( ZufyUIDsl.h , optional) : root() takes any Layout subclass; add() dispatches on the container's real API ( GridLayout requires .cell(row,col,child) or dsl::Cell(...) ); null children ( nullptr / empty Ref ) are always ignored; with() takes member function pointers only — use apply(lambda) for multi-step logic; WindowApp::run() calls Show() ( Window::Create does not show the window), so use .hidden() to start hidden.
